sources.shortCitation: “Denkst Du noch an jeden Tag,” manuscript, Kaper Papers 03193, box 1
sources.fullCitation: “Denkst Du noch an jeden Tag.” Fox-trott. Manuscript in Bronisław Kaper’s hand, headed “Text: Egon Schubert / Mus. B. Kaper” and dated “Berlin 1929”; piano and voice. Bronislaw Kaper Papers, Collection 03193, box 1. American Heritage Center, University of Wyoming, Laramie. Copies carry the Center’s notice that the material may be restricted by United States copyright law. Finding aid consulted 20 August 2026.
